title: Agent-loaded text byte budgets
summary: Each file_byte_budget=PATH:BYTES line in .yoke/project.config caps one file's bytes. The pre-commit hook and yoke check file-line refuse a changed file past its budget with file_byte_budget_exceeded and the recovery: shrink it, or move the text to its one owner and leave a pointer. Malformed, duplicate and stale entries also refuse. Yoke budgets AGENTS.md, the source-dev doctrine, the harness session rules and every agent operation home.
